partial-update-no-atomic-truncated-annou.mechanism: p#refill-region has role="status" but the developer set aria-atomic="false" EXPLICITLY (overriding the role's atomic default), so on update AT presents only the changed subtree. The 'Request a refill' click handler rewrites ONLY the inner span.num#refill-count (3->2), so AT announces the bare number, dropping the surrounding 'You have' / 'refills remaining' text nodes that carry the meaning.
partial-update-no-atomic-truncated-annou.scenario: MyHealth patient-portal prescriptions page: 'You have 3 refills remaining' wrapped in p#refill-region[role=status][aria-atomic=false]; clicking 'Request a refill' rewrites ONLY the inner span.num#refill-count 3->2, so AT announces a bare 'two' instead of 'two refills remaining'.
partial-update-no-atomic-truncated-annou.note: Wrong topic (medical prescription-refill counter, not a coffee-storefront cart), wrong region selector (p#refill-region not p#cart-region), wrong inner id (#refill-count not #cart-count), wrong text ('refills remaining' not 'items in cart'); also the scenario wrongly says aria-atomic is unset/spec-default when the page sets aria-atomic="false" explicitly.
